recommended_edit: Replace the diagnostic-only, mutually exclusive classification with a requirement to identify the critical bottleneck produced by an actual two-machine schedule, while retaining the JOB i and LOAD c output forms; make the selected bottleneck depend on schedule completion/ordering rather than merely on p1+p2 and the two aggregate loads.
